display_name: 投影细节分支第11轮异常：固定检查点的源端压力测试
description: 比较原投影细节版源训练 E10/E11 技术检查点，在源 draw11 固定压力样本上的提案、投影修正与输出误差。
authorization: Existing source-only technical diagnosis; original healthy training and future full Main evaluation remain unchanged.

code.environment: N607 CPU2, nice10, CUDA disabled. Actual original8cf release model, FP64 posterior and FP32 neural path.

data.version: Original R07 draw11 source L_s/U_s only; five fixed source-input stress strata of 32 each, at most160 unique records.
data.representation: Existing source clean/received IQ and original simulated source coefficient/noise metadata for deterministic stress selection.
data.physical_ids_ref: Original source row indices; groups may overlap and unique panel sorted.
data.label_map_ref: Unused for scoring. Original F0 default head used only in no-query smoke; continuous source features in numerical objectives.
data.validation_ref: Original R07 complete source cache and parent source-only E10/E11 recovery states.
data.support_query_ref: No V/OE/novel/target inputs, no source TX labels.
data.actual_training_labels: No optimization or labels. Frozen E10/E11 model forwards on original L_s/U_s clean/received source only.

permissions.query_use: At most160 L_s/U_s source rows, with source clean only for error metrics; no source TX, V/OE/novel or target.
permissions.claim_scope: Frozen model source stress outputs and projection amplification, not final model selection or target accuracy. Intermediate checkpoints are technical diagnostics only.

checkpoint.initialization: Original ProjectedPriorDetail E10/2470 and E11/2717 technical checkpoints, frozen eval only; original 8cf source release implementation loaded explicitly.
checkpoint.contract_check_ref: Exact original source-only smoke, original parent commit/config, epoch and updates, exact original release implementation, strict state load.
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Original G trained on source L_s/U_s and source F0 feature guidance; no TX/V/OE/target. Checkpoints are read-only for technical analysis.
checkpoint.selection_rule: E10/E11 fixed by source training anomaly boundary, never for deployment or target scoring. Source sample selection uses only fixed input/noise statistics.

execution.gpu_policy: CPU only, CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES empty, two CPU threads and nice10; no GPU process.
execution.stop_rule: Source/provenance/config mismatch, nonfinite model/output, residual>1e-8 on actual source2 smoke or process error: preserve and stop. No target/model update or changes to active parent.

metric_names: Proposal and projected correction NMSE, norm amplification, base and deployed IQ NMSE, posterior residual; per-source stress group and each checkpoint.
Five deterministic groups:32 evenly spaced,32 largest received peaks,32 largest simulator coefficient peaks,32 smallest and32 largest scalar variances. Groups overlap.
No inference on target and no identity/accuracy or finite-sample upper-bound claim. Frozen endpoints cannot reconstruct intermediate E11 minibatch weights.
dimensions: original E10 or E11 technical state
metrics_plan.scorer_ref: Source clean IQ error only; no TX truth.

rows.purpose: Locate whether source input extremes and the projected prior correction can reproduce large finite amplification near the E11 spike.
rows.seed_notes: Exact parent seed2026092701; fixed deterministic source draw11 stress groups.
rows.scenario: Source L_s/U_s draw11 only; no V/OE/target.
rows.budget_ref: At most160 unique source rows×two original fixed G checkpoints; two source smoke rows per checkpoint. No F0 calls, gradients or optimization.

notes: Parent source loss jumped at E11; diagnostic does not stop, change or restart healthy original training.
Stress selection uses only source input and simulation metadata, never TX or target; overlapping groups are not representative random strata.
Original model release is imported ahead of the diagnostic code so its posterior arithmetic and parameter layout match E10/E11 exactly.
Two focused tests and one independent P0/P1 review passed. Real E10/E11 source2 smoke precedes all stress forwards.
A nonreproduction at frozen boundaries cannot exclude a transient within-epoch optimizer state or another unselected source record.
